desc:
We built Lehri to hold up in a close-up cutscene and still work in gameplay. Most of the hours went into her face: a sculpt-driven likeness with real skin breakup that reads well under cinematic lighting.

Her outfit is built in real layers, with the blouse, corset, holster, skirt and ruffled underskirt as separate pieces, so it's ready for cloth sim. Hair is cards, kept light enough for gameplay. Topology is clean quads with deformation loops where animators need them, so your riggers can pick her up and go.

Making a western or period game? We'll build yours to your style, budget and platform.
textures: PBR, five 4K and two 2K texture sets
software: ZBrush, Maya, Substance Painter, Marmoset Toolbag
